summary: Read Node Buffer integer, BigInt, float, and double values with method-specific width/endian/bounds semantics.

target.notes: Modern Node validates offsets as integers and does not perform the old implicit uint32 offset coercion. Variable-width integer methods support only documented byte lengths.

semantics.number_integer_widths: 1/2/4 fixed, or documented variable widths up to 6 bytes
semantics.bounds: Node Buffer error categories must be preserved
semantics.return: Number for numeric methods; BigInt for BigInt methods

tests.name: BigInt and float
tests.input: const {Buffer}=require("node:buffer"); const b=Buffer.alloc(8); b.writeBigUInt64LE(5n); console.log(b.readBigUInt64LE()); b.writeDoubleLE(1.5); console.log(b.readDoubleLE());

tests.name: bounds error
tests.expected_behavior: prints Node buffer bounds error code
